bagPolicy.summary: Le Poisson Rouge hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Le Poisson Rouge hasn't published parking details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Le Poisson Rouge. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Seated events have a Mediterranean menu of shareable small plates and locally made desserts, while standing shows have limited snacks from the bar. LPR takes cash, all major credit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
concessions.quote: We offer a Mediterranean focused menu of shareable small plates and locally made desserts for our seated events only.

accessibility.summary: There is an elevator down to the main room. When you arrive, let the door staff know you'll need elevator access.
accessibility.quote: Yes. We have an elevator down to the main room.

reEntry.summary: Le Poisson Rouge hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens on show days one hour before the listed door time. Will call needs a valid photo ID and can't be picked up before the show. At 18+ shows, guests under 18 need a legal guardian, and 21+ shows admit no one under 21.
ticketPickup.quote: Our box office is open on show days starting one hour before the listed door time.

gates.summary: LPR is on the south side of Bleecker Street between Thompson and Sullivan. The nearest subway is West 4th Street on the A, C, E, B, D, F and M; exit at West 3rd Street, walk east to MacDougal, turn right, then left on Bleecker.
gates.quote: (Le) Poisson Rouge is on the south side of Bleecker Street between Thompson & Sullivan
